title: The workout-complete card says 'Lighter than previous' while every exercise under it says 'same' and no reason is given
what: The big kg-lifted card calls a workout lighter as soon as it is 1 kg under the previous one. Each exercise row only counts a change of 5% or more, and the 'Mostly ...' reason only appears for a total change of 5% or more. So a workout 2% lighter shows 'Lighter than previous' on top, 'same' on every exercise row, and no reason at all.
expected: The headline and its rows use one rule: a small dip reads 'About the same' like the rows, or when the card says lighter, the rows or a reason line show where the kilos went.
how_often: every workout finished between 1 kg and 5% under the previous one
fix_line: Make the big card use the same 'about the same' band as the exercise rows, or always show the main reason when it says lighter

title: A short workout is 'not compared' in the big card, then compared anyway in the line right under it
what: When today's workout is much shorter than the previous one, the big card deliberately skips the comparison and says 'A shorter workout than the previous one. Every workout counts.' But the comparison line below it still appears, saying for example '45% less kg lifted than Push 1 on 15 Oct', with the exercise list and its 'Mostly ...' reason. The member gets the exact discouraging comparison the card was changed to avoid.
expected: When the card decides a workout is too short to compare, the line below does not compare it either.
how_often: every workout under 60% of the previous one's reps and kilos
fix_line: Apply the short-workout rule to the comparison line too, not only the big card

title: The easy week's end date shows on the Workout tab and Start screen but not during the workout
what: The easy-week note on the Workout tab and the Start screen says 'Until <date>'. The same note inside a live workout never gets the date, so it only says 'Easy week: half the sets, the same weights.' The note's own rule says the end date is always on screen when known.
expected: The live workout's easy-week note shows the same end date as the other two places.
how_often: every workout in an easy week
fix_line: Pass the plan's easy-week end date to the note in the live workout

items.reason: This area shows workout facts (kg lifted vs previous, kg to beat, days trained, easy-week end, today's gym workout), not gym facts like alerts, dues, plan end or birthdays. Compared in code: finish card vs finish line, Start screen vs live card kg to beat (same plan function, drop sets left out on both), month calendar count vs report share picture (same de-duplicated day list), easy-week end on three screens. Workout data lives on the phone, so the Crispy Curves server data holds none of it to recount.

Date-worked numbers: easy-week end (dated window vs planned week; a plan that starts later counts as week 1), chart range start and opening range (an exercise last done long ago opens on Year or All time, existing finding), the workout compared with (picked by start time; a long gap shows the old date in the Previous line). The month calendar counts days, not workouts.
No new wrong-at-the-edge number beyond the existing chart opening-range finding.

Finish card total vs its exercise rows: same workout and kilo rule, but different 'same' bands. Chart range total vs its points: same range start; the total counts easy weeks and every workout on purpose (documented).
Opened the number-making files: kg hero, workout compare, coach note, exercise chart, plan state, easy week, reports.

Finish card number: kgHero over the session totals; its rows: exerciseDeltas over each exercise. Chart total: rangeTotal over the history; its points: bestPerDay plus pointsInRange. Month count and its cells: the same day list.

Long gap: the card and its rows use the same compared workout however old, and the Previous line names its date; the chart total and points use the same range start. The mismatch found is the size band, not the gap.
